# The test matrix's lint and JS-parse tools: flake8, and esprima (tests/template_actions_test.py
# parses static/js with it — without it that gate skips). Pinned to exact versions AND hashes.
#
# This directory runs on EVERY matrix Python, 3.10 included, so it is its own Dependabot entry:
# the marker on flake8 makes Dependabot resolve it as 3.10, as bandit.txt's does 3.11 for
# .github/ci-requirements. It is a sibling, not a subdirectory, because Dependabot's scan of a
# directory also reads the requirement files one level below it.
#
# esprima publishes only an sdist, so this file installs with `--require-hashes
# --no-build-isolation` after build.txt: build isolation would fetch setuptools unpinned.
esprima==4.0.1 \
    --hash=sha256:08db1a876d3c2910db9cfaeb83108193af5411fc3a3a66ebefacd390d21323ee
flake8==7.4.1 ; python_version >= "3.10" \
    --hash=sha256:78480274a6d7289d9cb8eafeda241fac57d4ea687d26e32dfdca37b72cdeddad \
    --hash=sha256:84ea5afcaf344487b0ea5baaebb8100f4cfaebc01f755998f75876664029f587
mccabe==0.7.0 \
    --hash=sha256:348e0240c33b60bbdf4e523192ef919f28cb2c3d7d5c7794f74009290f236325 \
    --hash=sha256:6c2d30ab6be0e4a46919781807b4f0d834ebdd6c6e3dca0bda5a15f863427b6e
pycodestyle==2.15.0 \
    --hash=sha256:12fd2f73c7b8ee8845a0431111df8faf4c1a07d6e64e2ee7f0c74014dab14181 \
    --hash=sha256:318f5db083869b4c4dad922d0b11124fb27ab181b6730b93371da671e31bd50e
